title: Install a Flatpak application
summary: Install a specific application from a Flatpak repository like Flathub. You can search for the app first to find its exact ID.
prerequisites: A remote repository (like flathub) is added

steps.explain: Search for the application to find its exact ID or name.

placeholders.name: SEARCH_TERM
placeholders.description: The name of the application you want to find

steps.explain: Install the application from the specified remote (usually flathub).

placeholders.name: REMOTE
placeholders.description: The name of the remote repository

placeholders.name: APP_ID
placeholders.description: The application ID found in the previous step

alternatives.explain: Install for the current user only (no root password needed).

placeholders.name: REMOTE
placeholders.description: The name of the remote repository

verify.expect: The installed application appears in the list.
